text:
Elaina: heads up — noticed a couple of slimlinks in docs/runtime that 404 on staging. Also one embedded image missing alt text. Can doc owners claim? Repro: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/runtime/shortlink (404)
Mike: which files?
Elaina: looks in docs/runtime/overview.md and docs/runtime/ops.md, slimlink ids s:4821 and s:4823
Carla: I own runtime docs, will take these. I'll open a PR to replace the shortlinks and add alt text. @docs-bot can you create an issue for the slimlink hits?
docs-bot: Created issue #4821 and #4823 and added labels (docs/shortlink, triage).
Carla: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — replace slimlinks with full paths and add alt text. Quick patch I ran: `sed -i 's|/s/4821|/docs/runtime/overview|g' docs/runtime/*.md`
Mike: tiny nit — please add meaningful alt text: `alt="runtime diagram — request flow"` for the image in ops.md
Carla: good call, added alt text and also updated frontmatter `owner: @Carla`
Alice: LGTM, ran link check locally, tests pass. Merging in 5 if no objections :tada:
Elaina: thanks! can we also add a one-liner to the docs contribution checklist to run `./scripts/find-slimlinks.sh` pre-merge?
Carla: added checklist entry in the same PR, will merge and close the issues after CI finishes. Closing loop.
